subject: [PATCH v6 RESEND 4/5] mm/memcontrol: move memory stock to page counters

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch moves the memory stock from memcg to page counters, allowing for more flexibility in managing memory usage. The transition is done while preserving the legacy user-visible memory <= memory+swap invariant. The patch also removes unused memcg code and prepares for future work on introducing additional page counters without affecting cgroup v2 users.
